core.headline: Extended 1930s semi-detached house in Sevenoaks
core.listing:
A four-bedroom semi-detached house with a 2021 kitchen/family room extension and a 2019 loft conversion. Oak Lane is approx. 0.8 miles from Sevenoaks station, with services to London Bridge in approx. 25 minutes.

The sitting room measures 4.55m x 3.70m into bay (14'11" x 12'2" into bay) and features a log burner. The dining room measures 3.60m x 3.40m (11'10" x 11'2"). The kitchen/family room extension, built in 2021, measures 7.80m x 5.10m max (25'7" x 16'9" max) and is fitted with an island and bi-fold doors to the garden; underfloor heating serves this room. A ground-floor shower room and utility room occupy the former garage. The original stained-glass front door and hall window remain.

The principal bedroom measures 4.20m x 3.60m (13'9" x 11'10"). Three further bedrooms include the loft conversion, which measures 5.20m x 3.30m max (17'1" x 10'10" max) and has an en-suite shower room; a building regulations completion certificate was issued for this conversion in 2019. A family bathroom serves the other bedrooms.

The south-west-facing rear garden extends approx. 30m (100ft) and includes a patio and a garden office with power. A driveway provides parking for two cars.

Sevenoaks School and Knole Park are nearby.

Guide Price £975,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band F (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard – Brick and render under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity, water (metered) and sewerage are mains-connected. Gas central heating; underfloor heating in kitchen/family room. FTTP broadband, up to 900Mbps. Good indoor and outdoor coverage for mobile signal. Driveway for two cars. The 2021 rear extension was built with planning permission.
core.summary: Extended 1930s semi-detached house with 2021 kitchen/family room extension, 2019 loft conversion with en-suite, garden office and parking. Approx. 0.8 miles from Sevenoaks station (London Bridge approx. 25 minutes).
